features.name: Overview
reach: Header Management pill → Overview (the default screen on load)

subFeatures.what: Stat tiles for Total Clinics, In Outreach, Needs Follow-Up and Walkthroughs Ready
Recent Activity and Upcoming Follow-Ups lists
Add Lead button opens the new-lead form

features.endState: The four stat tiles show clinic counts from the lead data, the Recent Activity and Upcoming Follow-Ups lists fill in, and Add Lead opens the new-lead form.

features.name: Inbox / WhatsApp
reach: Kanban Board → lead card → Chat button (title 'Open WhatsApp chat')

subFeatures.what: Read a clinic's WhatsApp conversation and see messages appended to it
Send a WhatsApp message to a clinic; with Autopilot off it opens a wa.me link and is logged as Sent Manually
Generate three AI reply suggestions for the conversation
Dental clinics are WhatsApp-only; SMS, email and Instagram are refused
Log a customer's reply by hand (Log Customer Reply), which marks the lead Replied and runs AI

features.endState: Opening a clinic shows its thread; a sent message appears in the thread as Queued or Sent Manually; Generate Suggestions shows three replies; after Log Customer Reply the lead shows as Replied on the Kanban Board.
gotchas: Log Call and Log Customer Reply sit side by side in the thread header; on narrow screens the reply button reads 'Log Reply'.
With Autopilot off, a send returns a wa.me link and is logged as Sent Manually; nothing is sent by the bot.

features.name: Kanban Board
reach: Management sidebar → Kanban Board → All Active Pipeline
Management sidebar → Kanban Board → Review Tray (Ready)
Management sidebar → Kanban Board → Due Today & Overdue
Management sidebar → Kanban Board → Hot Demo Viewers
Management sidebar → Kanban Board → Active Replies
Management sidebar → Kanban Board → Archived & DNC

subFeatures.what: Six saved views under Kanban Board: All Active Pipeline, Review Tray (Ready), Due Today & Overdue, Hot Demo Viewers, Active Replies, Archived & DNC
Drag a lead card into another stage column
Archive a lead so it leaves the active board
Assign unbatched early-stage leads into batches
Filter the board by text (Filter board, or the / key)

handles: Log raw call & generate AI notes
features.endState: Each stage column lists its leads; after a drag and a reload the card sits in the new column; a smart view shows only its matching leads; an archived lead is gone from the columns and appears only under Archived & DNC.
gotchas: Archived and do-not-contact leads are hidden from the active views and show only under Archived & DNC.

features.name: Leads Table

subFeatures.what: All active leads in one table with locality, stage and next step
Select leads and move them together to a stage (Move to Stage...)
Filter the table (Filter table, or the / key) and reset the filters

features.endState: The table lists the active leads; after selecting rows and choosing Move to Stage..., the moved leads show their new stage.
gotchas: The leads API leaves archived leads out unless include_archived is set, so an archived lead does not show in the default list.

features.name: Call Briefs
reach: Kanban Board → lead card → Call (title 'Log raw call & generate AI notes')

subFeatures.what: Pre-call brief for a clinic: talking points, objections and past commitments
Log a call conversation against a clinic (Log Call)
The AI turns a logged call into five sections: summary, interests, objections, commitments and next steps

features.endState: Choosing a clinic shows its brief; after Log & Structure Call the call is listed with its summary, interests, objections, commitments and next steps.
gotchas: Force regenerate brief calls the AI again; the brief is otherwise kept until it is invalidated.

features.name: Attention & Velocity
reach: Header 'Cockpit' pill → Sidebar 'Attention & Velocity' (the default Cockpit tab)

subFeatures.what: Four attention lists: follow-ups due, unreplied inbound messages, today's actions, call preparation
Velocity view of how fast leads move through the pipeline
Six-step pipeline status: Discovery, Verification, Deep Research, Next.js Build, Walkthrough, Review Tray
Live event stream and terminal logs from the running work
Supervisor bar showing whether Autopilot is running, with Emergency abort

features.endState: The four attention lists show leads needing action; the supervisor bar says whether Autopilot is running; the pipeline shows the six steps with their status.
gotchas: Keys 1-4 switch Cockpit tabs only when focus is not in a text field, and they do nothing while the Outreach tab is open.
Emergency abort (on the supervisor bar) halts all scraping, probes and video recording workers, not just the tab you are on.

features.name: Discovery Engine

subFeatures.what: Start Lead Discovery: search a locality for dental clinics and stage the ones that qualify
Tiered source waterfall (Google Places, Practo, local pool, web search) that moves on when a source's quota is spent
Keeps clinics with a WhatsApp-capable mobile and no own website, and drops duplicates
Website check: a clinic counts as having its own site only if it is not a directory or news result

features.endState: After Start Lead Discovery, newly staged clinics appear in the discovery table with a verification badge, and the discovery console lists the run's log lines.
gotchas: Key 2 switches to this tab only when focus is not in a text field.

features.name: Demo Factory
reach: Cmd+K → Run Stock Refill Batch (starts the full pipeline)

subFeatures.what: Build a batch: staged clinics become demo packages marked DEMO_READY
Preview a demo at phone and desktop sizes in the multi-device drawer
Re-Batch Stock: re-split the staged clinics into batches
Re-record walkthroughs and retry failed or pending videos
Run Stock Refill Batch: the seven-step pipeline from discovery to the Review Tray

features.endState: After a build, the batch lists its clinics as DEMO_READY, each with a preview link that opens the demo; a failed video shows a retry action.
gotchas: Run Stock Refill Batch (Cmd+K) calls the refill route, which runs the whole pipeline, not only the build.

features.name: Outreach Automation

subFeatures.what: Dispatch queue of WhatsApp messages; with automation on, sends queue for the WhatsApp sender
Mark a clinic's message sent or unsent by hand
Safety brakes: no double send to the same step, a STOP reply sets Do-Not-Contact, and quota gauges and caps
Run the Closer agent

features.endState: The queue lists the pending clinic messages; Send Now or the automation moves a message to Sent Manually or Sent; Stop WA Automation halts the sending.
gotchas: Keys 1-4 do not switch tabs while Outreach is open.
A clinic that replies STOP is set to Do-Not-Contact; later sends to it are refused with HTTP 403.

features.name: Settings
reach: Profile menu (bottom of the sidebar, title 'Captain Profile & Settings') → Settings
Cmd+K → a Settings section (e.g. Quotas & Safety Caps)

subFeatures.what: Hustle & Blueprint: the side hustles, their autonomy mode, delivery steps and target deal value
Discovery Waterfall: the four discovery tiers and their search queries, with fallback routing
Quotas & Safety Caps: daily channel limits, batch size and a dry-run safety simulation
MCP & AI Provider: AI provider keys (Gemini, Groq) and the MCP server
Appearance & UI: theme, reduced motion and table density
Operator Profile: name, monogram and message sign-off

features.endState: The modal opens on a section; a saved AI provider key shows as configured; a changed operator name shows in the sidebar account card.
gotchas: Two Settings screens exist. Users reach the modal (⌘, or the profile menu). The page in features/settings/HustleSettingsView.tsx renders only when activeTab is 'settings', and nothing sets that tab, so it is unreachable and the sidebar's Settings list never shows.
The sidebar calls the MCP section 'MCP & Integrations'; the modal calls it 'MCP & AI Provider'.
The Registered MCP Tools list is a hardcoded array (REAL_MCP_TOOLS in SettingsModal.tsx), not read from backend/mcp_server.py, so it can drift from the server.

features.name: Evening Sprint
reach: Profile menu (bottom of the sidebar) → Day Schedule

subFeatures.what: Ranked list of tasks by expected value per minute, fitted to a minutes budget
Click a task row to open that clinic's Lead Card

features.endState: A ranked list of clinics with minutes per row, the total stays within the budget, and clicking a row opens that clinic's Lead Card.
gotchas: The sidebar has no Sprint entry; it sits in the profile menu under the label 'Day Schedule'.
Day mode (normal, away, off) has an API and a context action but no control in the UI, so the app cannot set it.

features.name: Command Palette (Cmd+K)
reach: Cmd+K or Ctrl+K on any screen
Header search bar ('Search clinics, doctors, settings, actions...')

subFeatures.what: Find clinics and doctors by name, and filter by All, Clinics, Doctors, Actions or Settings
Jump to Pipeline Kanban Board, Full Leads Table, Executive Dashboard or Evening Sprint Mode
Run actions: + Add New Lead, Run Stock Refill Batch, Verify Demo Previews & Sync
Open a Settings section in the Settings modal

features.endState: A dialog opens over the page; typing filters the results; Enter runs the chosen item and closes the dialog.
gotchas: Cmd+K toggles the palette (pressing it again closes it), and Escape closes it too.
Settings items open the Settings modal, not the Settings tab.

features.name: Add New Lead

subFeatures.what: Register a clinic: doctor name, primary phone, locality or city, Instagram handle and the first next step

features.endState: After saving, the new clinic shows up in the Leads Table after a refresh.
gotchas: A clinic name is required (the form says 'Clinic / Lead name is required'), and the first next step is a required field.

features.name: Lead Detail
reach: Kanban Board → click a lead card
Calls → Open universal Lead Card drawer
Evening Sprint → click a task row
Cockpit attention cards → click a card

subFeatures.what: Lead Card: the clinic's facts, stage and history
Watch or download the demo walkthrough video

features.endState: The drawer shows the clinic name and stage; once a walkthrough exists its video plays; Close drawer returns to the screen.
gotchas: Until a walkthrough exists the recording endpoint returns 404, so the card has no video.

features.name: Ask & Do AI
reach: Floating 'Ask & Do AI' button, bottom right (Management surface only)

subFeatures.what: Ask a question or ask it to act: find clinics, move a lead's stage, draft a message
Problem report modal: captures a diagnostic brief for a bug report

features.endState: The drawer answers in text and lists the actions it executed; a clinic named in the answer can be opened.
gotchas: The drawer is not rendered on the Cockpit surface, so the assistant is unavailable there.
Nothing in the frontend opens the problem report modal (no code sets it open), so assistant.problem-report cannot be reached yet.

features.name: Autopilot toggle
reach: Sidebar 'Toggle Autopilot' icon (collapsed and expanded sidebar)
Sidebar Autopilot card → Pause / Enable button

subFeatures.what: Turn global automation on or off; the dot is emerald for Autopilot Active and amber for Autopilot Paused
With automation on, sends queue for the WhatsApp sender; with it off, they open a wa.me link

features.endState: The sidebar dot turns emerald with 'Outreach & guards live' when Autopilot is active, or amber with 'Manual review mode' when paused; sends then queue or open wa.me as described.
gotchas: The toggle changes only the outreach automation setting. Stopping running discovery, build or recording work is done by the Cockpit's Stop and Emergency abort (/api/autopilot/stop).
